criteria.rationale: The patient was born February 2, 1998, and was 28 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
The request is for Wegovy for chronic weight management, consistent with the obesity treatment plan.
The latest structured BMI before the request was 31.1, meeting the BMI ≥30 threshold without a comorbidity requirement.
Dietitian-led program intake and follow-up document participation in dietary changes, food tracking, and physical activity.

Although the Zepbound order is marked stopped and the patient said in June she would discontinue it and not refill, an August 6 Zepbound dispense conflicts with that account. Concurrent use cannot be resolved safely.
Zepbound is also an Appendix 2 PA weight-loss medication. Its August dispense conflicts with the earlier stopped order and stated plan not to refill, leaving concurrent use unresolved.

review_reasons: Reconcile the August 6 Zepbound dispense with the stopped order and June statement that the patient would discontinue Zepbound; determine whether Zepbound is currently being used.
parsed.summary: Age, indication, BMI, and comprehensive weight-management-program participation meet policy requirements. An August Zepbound dispense conflicts with earlier discontinuation evidence, so both no-dual-therapy criteria require review before the PA can be considered ready.
